description: This file provides utility functions for device size detection and responsive font sizing in a React Native project, including device dimension calculations, normalization, and size adjustments based on device characteristics.

methods.name: getDeviceSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the device's diagonal size in inches, adjusted for iPad devices.

methods.name: getDpi
methods.description: Calculates dots per inch based on pixel density.

methods.name: correction
methods.description: Adjusts font size based on device size and pixel density, considering device type (tablet or not).

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes font size based on device pixel density.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns an object with various font sizes adjusted for device characteristics.

methods.name: updateSize
methods.description: Recalculates and updates font sizes and padding variables based on current device metrics.
